claim_scope: single-seed online same-distribution VDA4 competence test; not transfer or held-out evidence
hypothesis: A critic-dominant objective will stabilize value grounding while a middle-weight actor learns behavior and a low-weight JEPA objective regularizes rather than dominates the recurrent representation.
rationale: The preceding actor-0.01/critic-0.5/JEPA-0.6 run was numerically stable but behaviorally unstable: actual last-window contributions were roughly actor 0.0027, critic 0.043, JEPA 3.5, with 15-16% correctness and late H2 weakening. Coefficients are calibrated against those raw loss scales so actual window-averaged contributions should be critic > actor > JEPA.
behavior_cloning: disabled; alpha-zero pure-MPO path does not construct a BC loss
falsification: Actual rolling weighted contributions fail to remain critic > actor > JEPA, long-window correctness remains near or below chance, best rolling correctness fails to exceed the prior modern-run 57.75% peak and older 64-67% range, or theta never decreases.

architecture.visual_feedback: source-RMSNorm and QK-normalized crossattn1: Q=X; K/V=[X,H1_prev] under one inspectable softmax
architecture.memory1: source-RMSNorm; four-head QK-normalized attention; gated output; raw H1 then tokenwise feature softmax
architecture.memory2: source-RMSNorm; four-head QK-normalized attention; gated output; raw H2 then tokenwise feature softmax
architecture.initial_memory: learned slot-distinct H1_0/H2_0 logits, tokenwise softmaxed before first use

jepa.cross_entropy: temporal student@t predicts detached EMA-teacher@t+1 independently for H1/H2
jepa.center_update: EMA over valid timesteps only; padded tails excluded

curriculum.update: theta=max(theta_floor, theta-3deg) only when window correctness>=0.85

monitoring.decision_rule: Behavior and curriculum advancement dominate auxiliary loss values; weighted contribution ordering is checked on rolling windows, not every noisy minibatch.
